comment: The role is given as "Information and FHIR modellers, who design the data models, FHIR profiles, and actor definitions". Naming one standard in a role title narrows how countries staff a function that is not standard-specific: the same team maintains logical information models, terminology bindings and profiles in whichever formalisms the national architecture uses. In Slovenia this function spans openEHR archetypes and templates and FHIR profiles, and is staffed as one capability.
